room.title: ARCADE
room.tagline: Take the stairs down. The four lit machines on the back wall are live.

exit.label: EXIT
exit.description: Leave the arcade and return to The Nexus.

games.title: MINES
games.description: Clear safe tiles on a hidden grid. Each one raises your multiplier; hit a mine and the round ends.

games.title: DIAMONDS
games.description: Reveal gems and match stones. The more of the same stone you land, the higher the payout.

games.title: HOOPS
games.description: Time your shot and sink it. Longer shots pay more, and a miss resets your streak.

games.title: COLLECT CASH
games.description: Grab the cash as it drops and dodge the duds. The longer you last, the bigger the haul.
